tasks.author: ai-task-writer-h
tasks.prompt: Summarise, in a short paragraph, how a client should request a version and format from a repository and how it should handle what comes back.

rubric.text: The client lists every content type it supports in the Accept header; order carries no meaning, so preference needs quality values, and the recommended one is ;q=0.01 on legacy text/html unless that is the only type requested.
The server may pick any listed type or even an unrequested default, or answer 406 (300 is discouraged), so the client must check the Content-Type the server always sends.
Clients should name explicit versions rather than latest; when latest is requested the response carries the actual version's content type.
The format URL parameter is optional, takes a single content type with no wildcards or quality values, and clients should not rely on it.
The client-side recommendations are non-normative defaults, not requirements.

tasks.notes: cross-section: Version + Format Selection, Alternative Negotiation Mechanisms and Recommendations.
